name: ROLE You are a senior full-stack

messages.content:
ROLE
You are a senior full-stack engineer and product designer. Build "AdAudit" (working name), a SaaS web app for e-commerce store owners. They upload a Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) CSV export and get, in under 90 seconds, a forensic audit: every ad receives a KILL / FIX / SCALE / WAIT verdict, with the exact rule and metric that triggered it. The app also generates creative-strategy output (angles, hooks, scripts, briefs). No Meta account access and no Meta API: the user exports the CSV themselves.

FIRST STEP
Before writing code, give me a short plan: folder structure, data model, and the build phases below. Wait for my "go". Then build phase by phase and stop after each phase for review.

TARGET USERS
French-speaking e-commerce owners and dropshippers (France, Maghreb, francophone Africa), many selling Cash-On-Delivery. UI default language: French. Use next-intl so Arabic and English can be added later. Currency selectable (EUR, MAD, DZD, TND, USD, XOF).

TECH STACK
- Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
- Supabase: Auth (email + Google), Postgres, Storage, Row Level Security on every table
- Zod for validation, Papa Parse for CSV, Recharts for charts
- Payments: Stripe (keep the code provider-agnostic so I can switch to Lemon Squeezy)
- AI: provider abstraction layer (Anthropic or Gemini via env var)
- Deploy on Vercel. Provide a .env.example and a README.

PAGES / ROUTES
1. / Landing: promise ("Audit your Meta Ads in 90 seconds"), how it works (3 steps), a sample report preview, pricing, FAQ, "No account access needed" trust section.
2. /login, /signup
3. /app Dashboard: list of past audits, health score trend, "New audit" button.
4. /app/new Wizard: Step 1 Context, Step 2 Upload, Step 3 Column check, Step 4 Analysis (progress).
5. /app/audits/[id] Report page.
6. /app/creative/[auditId] Creative strategist page.
7. /app/settings: profile, language, currency, default context, delete my data.
8. /app/billing: plan, usage, upgrade.

STEP 1: CONTEXT FORM
Fields: niche (fashion, beauty, gadgets, home, health, other), average selling price, gross margin % (or product cost + shipping), currency, objective (profit / scale / test), average order value, optional COD toggle with confirmation rate % and delivery rate %.
Compute:
- breakeven_ROAS = 1 / margin
- if COD: effective_breakeven_ROAS = 1 / (margin x confirmation_rate x delivery_rate)
- breakeven_CPA = AOV x margin (adjusted for COD the same way)
Save these on the audit. Allow reusing saved context.

STEP 2: UPLOAD AND PARSING
- Accept .csv and .xlsx, max 10 MB, drag and drop, mobile friendly.
- Detect delimiter and encoding. Meta exports can be in French or English, with columns like: Ad name / Nom de la publicité, Amount spent / Montant dépensé, Impressions, Reach / Portée, Frequency / Fréquence, Link clicks / Clics sur le lien, CTR, CPM, CPC, Purchases / Achats, Purchase conversion value / Valeur de conversion des achats, Purchase ROAS, Cost per purchase, 3-second video plays, ThruPlays, Add to cart, Initiate checkout, Campaign name, Ad set name.
- Build a synonym dictionary (FR/EN) with fuzzy matching to map columns to an internal schema.
- Step 3 shows the detected mapping and lets the user fix it manually. Only spend plus one result metric are required. If a column is missing (for example video metrics), skip the related checks and say so in the report. Never invent data.
- Handle: totals row at the bottom, empty rows, decimal comma, currency symbols, percentages as text, duplicate ads, zero-impression rows.
- Show clear, friendly French error messages.

CALCULATION ENGINE (pure TypeScript functions, no AI, unit-tested)
Per ad compute: spend, impressions, CPM, link CTR, CPC, frequency, purchases, CPA, revenue, ROAS, hook rate = 3s plays / impressions, hold rate = ThruPlays / 3s plays, add-to-cart rate, checkout rate, conversion rate (purchases / link clicks). Also aggregate at ad set, campaign and account level. Same input must always give the same output (deterministic).

RULES ENGINE (configurable defaults, stored in one config file, each rule has an id and a French explanation)
Data sufficiency: if spend < 1 x breakeven_CPA and purchases = 0 -> WAIT ("not enough data").
- KILL: spend >= 1.5 x breakeven_CPA with 0 purchases; or spend >= 2 x breakeven_CPA and ROAS < 0.6 x breakeven_ROAS.
- SCALE: ROAS >= 1.3 x breakeven_ROAS, purchases >= 5 (or spend >= 3 x breakeven_CPA), frequency < 2.5.
- FIX: everything between. Attach a sub-diagnosis:
  a) hook rate < 25%: weak hook, new first 3 seconds
  b) hook ok but hold rate low: weak body/story
  c) good CTR but low conversion rate: landing page / offer problem
  d) frequency > 3 and CTR falling: creative fatigue
  e) CPM far above account average: audience or creative relevance issue
  f) high add-to-cart but low checkout: checkout/shipping/price friction
Every verdict card MUST show: verdict, the rule id, the exact metric values and thresholds that triggered it, and the 1-line action. These thresholds are heuristics, so show a small disclaimer and let the user edit thresholds in settings.

HEALTH SCORE AND WASTE
- Health score 0-100 from: share of spend on profitable ads, number of winning ads, creative diversity, fatigue, tracking sanity.
- Waste analysis: total spend on KILL ads, wasted amount in the user's currency, % efficiency loss, and "if you cut these ads you would have saved X".
- Add a warning if account-level ROAS looks inconsistent (possible tracking issue).

AI LAYER (the AI interprets; it never does arithmetic)
Send the AI only the computed metrics and verdicts as JSON, never raw files. Ask for strict JSON output validated with Zod, retry once on invalid JSON. AI produces:
1. Executive summary (5 lines max, plain French, no jargon)
2. Top 3 actions to do today in Ads Manager (specific)
3. Patterns across winning ads (hook style, format, offer)
4. Test plan for next week (3 tests with hypothesis)
Never let the AI change a verdict. If AI fails, still show the full rules-based report.

CREATIVE STRATEGIST MODULE
From the winning ads plus the niche and product, generate: 5 angles (pain point, desire, objection, social proof, curiosity), 3 hooks per angle (first 3 seconds, written and spoken), 2 short UGC scripts (15-30 s) with scene directions, and a creator brief ready to send (format, tone, do/don't, deliverables). Copy buttons and PDF export for each. Output in French by default.

REPORT PAGE LAYOUT
Top: health score gauge, wasted amount, number of KILL/FIX/SCALE/WAIT. Then: AI summary, top 3 actions, filterable and sortable ad table (verdict chips, expandable rows showing rule and metrics), charts (spend by verdict, ROAS vs spend scatter, hook rate vs hold rate), then creative section link. Include "Export PDF" and "Share link" (private, revocable, read-only).

HISTORY (retention feature)
When a user uploads a new audit for the same account name, show the comparison: health score trend, ROAS change, ads that moved from FIX to SCALE or SCALE to KILL.

PRICING AND LIMITS (configurable in one file)
- Free: 1 audit total, max 30 ads, summary visible, details blurred beyond the top 5 ads
- Starter: 5 audits/month
- Pro: unlimited audits, history, creative module, PDF, custom thresholds
Enforce limits server-side. Add Stripe checkout, customer portal and webhooks. Track AI cost per audit in the database.

DATABASE TABLES
profiles, accounts (ad accounts named by the user), contexts, audits (status, context snapshot, summary json, health_score), ad_rows (normalized metrics per ad), verdicts (ad_id, verdict, rule_id, details json), ai_outputs, creative_outputs, subscriptions, usage_events, share_links. RLS: users only access their own rows.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
- Server-side validation of every upload; never execute or trust file content; sanitize CSV formula injection when exporting.
- Rate limit uploads and AI calls. API keys server-side only.
- GDPR: privacy page, "Delete all my data" button, option to auto-delete raw files after analysis.
- Do not log ad data in third-party analytics.

DESIGN
Clean, modern, trustworthy dashboard. Mobile first (many users are on phones). Verdict colors: Kill red, Fix amber, Scale green, Wait gray. Always add an icon or label next to color (accessibility). Light and dark mode. Loading states with a progress bar and friendly French messages. Empty states with a "download a sample CSV" button.

TESTING
Unit tests for the calculation engine and every rule (include edge cases: zero spend, zero purchases, missing columns, decimal comma). Provide 3 sample CSV files (French, English, with and without video metrics). Add one end-to-end test for upload to report.

BUILD PHASES (stop after each for my review)
1. Project setup, auth, database, RLS, i18n
2. Context form, upload, parser, column mapping
3. Calculation engine and rules engine with tests
4. Report page, charts, health score, waste analysis
5. AI summary and actions
6. Creative strategist module and PDF export
7. History and comparison
8. Pricing, limits, Stripe
9. Landing page, polish, security review, deployment guide

Do not skip phases. Keep code simple, commented, and typed. Ask me before making any assumption that changes the product behavior.
